title: The platform at rest: cluster, node pools, storage, queues and services
design_ref: The infrastructure: environments, trajectories and credit workers
purpose: Show what was built before anything runs: a standard EKS cluster with a CPU pool and a GPU pool, the EBS CSI driver and the snapshot controller, the two environment queues, the rollout engine serving the policy, the trajectory store, the verifier with no network, and an empty store.

checks.description: the cluster is ACTIVE on Kubernetes 1.37, standard EKS (Auto Mode off)
checks.because: Terraform creates the cluster with no compute configuration; the nodes are managed node groups.

checks.description: two GPU nodes, one GPU each
checks.because: The GPU node group has two nodes of whichever listed one-GPU type EC2 had capacity for.

checks.description: the EBS CSI driver and the snapshot controller are installed as EKS add-ons
checks.because: Both are in the cluster layer; the driver's controller has its own AWS identity through EKS Pod Identity.

checks.description: a gp3 storage class and a VolumeSnapshotClass for EBS exist
primary rollouts own the environment capacity; branch rollouts own none and may only borrow it
checks.because: Two ClusterQueues in one cohort, with priority classes primary (1000) and branch-low (100).

checks.description: the rollout engine serves the policy (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at a pinned commit) under the name 'policy'
checks.because: vLLM 0.33.0 with prefix caching on, from the release image pinned by digest.

checks.description: environments may reach only the rollout engine, the platform services and DNS
checks.because: The env-egress NetworkPolicy lists exactly three destinations; the verifier's own policy has no egress at all.

checks.description: 32 tasks are published, and no hidden test is in the bucket
checks.because: Terraform uploads only the public half of each task; the hidden half is mounted into the verifier pods.

checks.description: nothing is running and the store holds no trajectory
